newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton trade remains slow.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton trade remains slow.

text.p: European raw cotton trading conditions remain slow, with asking levels for several origins appearing to be back on a downward track once more, industry sources said on Wednesday.
The result of this trend has been to reinforce the caution seen from mill buyers, they added.
The imminent movement of several Mediterranean crops was still considered an insurance against a potential upturn in prices.
Central Asian continues to account for the bulk of mill purchases, which are mainly for shipment before end 1996.
